build_symmetric_alignment: build symmetric word alignments for a parallel translation dataset using fast_align and mosesdecoder
run_forward_alignment: run forward fast_align on a joined source-target parallel corpus file
run_backward_alignment: run backward fast_align on a joined source-target parallel corpus file
join_parallel_corpus: join source and target language sentence files into a single pipe-delimited corpus file
symmetrize_alignment: symmetrize forward and backward alignment passes using a Moses decoder heuristic
